player_prompt.intro:
Wo wɔ dan mu a ɛwɔ {num_buttons} nkɔmmɔtwen: {buttons}. Nkɔmmɔtwen biara wɔ Bernoulli nkyɛnkyɛm a ɛwɔ ɔman a wɔnnim; ɔman a ɛwɔ nkɔmmɔtwen no mu betumi ayɛ soronko.
Ma nkɔmmɔtwen biara, bere a wɔbɛpɛ mu no, wubehu akatua a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde firi nkyɛnkyɛm no mu.
Wo wɔ {num_turns} bere tɔn no, na wubetumi apaw nkɔmmɔtwen biara wɔ bere tɔn biara mu na wuhu akatua no.
Wo botae ne sɛ wubɛyɛ nkɔmmɔtwen no yie wɔ bere tɔn biara mu sɛnea wubehu nsɛm wɔ wɔn akatua nkyɛnkyɛm ho, a ɛbɛma wupaw nkɔmmɔtwen a ɛwɔ akatua kɛse sen biara no mu bere a {num_turns} no bɛba awiee no.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɔbɔadeɛ no amfa ɔkwan a ɛfata so antwe n'adwene amma.

game_action.pressed: Wopɛ {button} botɔn no na wanya yɛnhyɛ a ɛyɛ {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Sɛ woayɛ biribi a, hwɛ sɛ wode sika no nyinaa ayɛ adwuma ahwɛ nea wobɛtumi de asi w'ani so. Afei susuw ho hu nea ɛyɛ papa paa wɔ hɔ.

outcome.win: W'ani agye! Woapaw button a ɛfata no.
outcome.lose: Wapaw button a ɛnyɛ no yiye.
